name: Cursewood
description: A cursed, Infernal-tainted forest visited by an earlier expedition of magi, where an infernal artifact lies hidden.

name: Magnus the Quaesitor
description: A Quaesitor investigating a Hermetic maga suspected of diabolism who asks veteran magi to help pursue the criminals into the Cursewood.

name: Quaesitor
description: Hermetic investigator of crimes against the Order, such as diabolism.

name: Hoplite
description: An enforcer who tracks criminals on behalf of Quaesitores.

name: Grog
description: Mundane covenant servants and guards who accompany magi on expeditions.

name: Infernal Artifact of the Cursewood
description: An Infernal artifact that can reform or move to another form if destroyed; it can only be permanently destroyed in a place of Dominion aura 5+ by an ordained clergyman with True Faith spending a Faith Point.

name: Terentia
description: A figure who is forever drawn to the Infernal artifact of the Cursewood wherever it is hidden.

name: Diabolism
description: Infernalist practice; a Hermetic maga and her infernalist cohorts are suspected of it.

name: True Faith
description: Holy virtue possessed by pious clergy; needed to destroy the Infernal artifact of the Cursewood.

name: Faith Point
description: A point of Faith spent to invoke divine power, e.g. to destroy an Infernal artifact.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura of a place, rated by strength and Realm (Divine/Dominion, Faerie, Magic, Infernal), e.g. Inner Farne has Divine aura 2.

name: Divine
description: One of the four supernatural realms; represented at the Farne Islands by Saint Cuthbert's miracle-working hermitage.

name: Faerie
description: Supernatural realm of faeries, who dwell in the legends of the villages near the Farne Islands.

name: Magic
description: Supernatural realm whose travelers migrate with the seabirds of the Farnes; Big Harcar is a vestige leading into it.

name: Infernal
description: Realm of demons; represented at the Farne Islands by the demons imprisoned on Megstone.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi; the duel at the Poisoned Earth is famous within it.

name: The Gift
description: The magical Gift, whose presence heightens the superstition of Northumbrian sailors.

name: Farne Islands
description: A group of about 28 islands off the Northumberland coast, avoided by locals as demon-haunted, touched by all four supernatural realms.

name: Northumberland
description: The northernmost county of England, troubled by Scottish invasions, administered by the king's sheriff at Newcastle; contains the Farne Islands.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: The Hermetic Tribunal in whose territory the Farne Islands and Somerset lie.

name: Saint Cuthbert
description: Seventh-century hermit and later bishop who lived on Inner Farne, performed miracles there, and drove the demons out to Megstone; the most popular saint in Northern England.

name: Inner Farne
description: The largest Farne island (16 acres), also called House Island, with Divine aura 2 rising to 4 in Saint Cuthbert's chapel and hermitage.

name: Holy Island
description: Island seven miles up the coast from the Farnes, home to Lindisfarne Priory.

name: Lindisfarne Priory
description: Priory on Holy Island famed for illuminated scriptures; its library holds the Vitae of Saint Cuthbert and Bede's works.

name: Staple Sound
description: A mile-wide channel separating the inner and outer Farne Islands.

name: Newcastle
description: Seat of the king's sheriff who administers Northumberland; an English port.

name: Bamburgh Castle
description: Heavily garrisoned English fortress, former capital of Bernicia and Northumbria, whose constable holds wardship over the Farne Islands.

name: Bernicia
description: Saxon kingdom whose capital was Bamburgh.

name: Northumbria
description: Saxon kingdom, successor to Bernicia, with its capital at Bamburgh.

name: John Wascelin
description: Current constable of Bamburgh Castle with nominal suzerainty over the Farne Islands.

name: Seahouses
description: Fishing village on the Northumberland coast where a boat can be hired to the Farnes.

name: The Wideopens
description: Twin islands (East and West Wideopen) with the deepest soil, used to bury shipwrecked sailors; a regio tunnel links East Wideopen to the mainland.

name: The Kettle
description: Deep calm pool on the north side of Inner Farne, the island's only harbor, kept calm by Eider Ducks of Virtue.

name: Knoxes Reef
description: Inner Farne feature that remains above water at high tide.

name: Selkie
description: Faeries who take the shape of seals; the women make Faerie spouses trapped by their seal-skins, the men are skilled lovers.

name: Megstone
description: Isolated rock with Infernal aura 1 where Saint Cuthbert imprisoned 144 demons, trapped at zero Might for centuries.

name: Bartholomew
description: Hermit who dwelt at Inner Farne from 1150 to 1193 and wrote the Farne Meditations.

name: Farne Meditations
description: Book by the hermit Bartholomew; a Summa on Divine Lore, Level 3, Quality 6, recording his spiritual insights.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power harvested from sources, measured in pawns of a given Art (e.g. Creo vis from barley on Inner Farne).

name: Profession: Sailor
description: Ability used to pilot and navigate boats.

name: Area Lore
description: Knowledge of a region, e.g. Area Lore: Northumberland, Somerset, British Isles.

name: Athletics
description: Ability used for rowing and physical feats.

name: Saint Cuthbert's Gut
description: Channel between West Wideopen and Inner Farne, dangerous in stormy weather.

name: Regio
description: A supernatural layered area; the tunnel from East Wideopen and the Islestone/Glororum Shads lie within one with Magic aura.

name: Drowned Dead
description: Revenant corpses of sailors buried on the Wideopens that emerge from the tunnel on All Hallow's Eve.

name: The Bridges
description: Inner Farne features (with Solan Rock and Knocklin Ends) forming a crescent island at low tide; Aquam vis spume collects here on Saint Cuthbert's feast day.

name: Big and Little Scarcar
description: Two rock pillars in the inner Farnes with a narrow gut where a small boat can be moored safely.

name: The Bush
description: Paired islets with Divine aura 1 where Saint Cuthbert meditated for a year underwater; a site for a Test of Faith.

name: Test of Faith
description: An ordeal that can raise a character's Faith Score, such as a year spent on the Bush.

name: Concentration
description: Ability used with Stamina to survive prayerfully while submerged on the Bush.

name: Outer Farnes
description: The outer group of Farne islands, haunted by demons in local belief and home to faeries and magical creatures.

name: Staple Island
description: Outer island with Faerie aura 2 (5 in undersea grottoes), seat of the selkie king's court.

name: Selkie King
description: Faerie king of the selkies who holds court under Staple Island; his hidden name, which is external vis, was stolen by Brown Wullie.

name: Grey Seal
description: Variegated seals that haul out on the Farnes to breed; statistics given for cow and bull seals.

name: Skeney Car
description: Southernmost tip of Staple Island; any mortal jumping into the sea there is brought to the selkie king's court.

name: Osgood
description: Hermit abjurer living on Crumstone who is a Drowned Man serving Leviathan by luring ships onto Big Harcar, while also rescuing mariners.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Knowledge of faeries; its possessors know selkie traditions and the nature of the King's Name.

name: Brown Wullie
description: Leader of six exiled rebel selkies on Brownsman Island who has stolen the selkie king's name.

name: Selkie Blood
description: Virtue indicating descent from selkies, possibly from the selkie king.

name: Brownsman Island
description: Outer island with Faerie aura 2 occupied by rebel selkies; joined to Staple Island at low water.

name: Brownsman's Gut
description: Channel separating Brownsman Island from Staple Island at high tide.

name: North Wamses
description: Magical island being competing in size with South Wamses; wide but squat.

name: South Wamses
description: Magical island being, tall but narrow, plotting with the Nameless Rock to outgrow North Wamses.

name: The Wamses
description: Two islands that are Magic Things (Magic Might 25 Terram) fighting for dominance by changing size, yielding Muto and Terram vis.

name: Nameless Rock
description: Magic Thing island east of South Wamses, conspiring to join with it.

name: Wamses Gut
description: Channel forming between North and South Wamses at high tide.

name: Faerie Heritage
description: Story Flaw a player taking Brown Wullie as character would have.

name: The King's Name
description: The selkie king's name, a form of audible vis (five pawns of Animal) trapped in a seashell; using it destroys the king.

name: Orogenesis
description: Power of the Wamses (CrTe 20) adding rock to the island at the cost of permanent Might.

name: The Longest Race
description: Power of the Wamses (ReTe 30) letting an island heave itself a few paces.

name: Magic Thing
description: Creature Virtue for magical beings such as the Wamses and the arsenical pseudoelemental.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power rating of creatures (Magic, Faerie or Infernal Might), spent to use powers.

name: Roddam and Green
description: Two rocky pillars in Piper Gut; once per year Roddam gains a Magic aura and a present person can judge the Wamses' contest for Intellego vis.

name: Piper Gut
description: Wide channel separating Big Harcar from North Wamses.

name: Big and Little Harcar
description: Islands with Magic aura 2; Big Harcar is a level 4 vestige tethered to Leviathan and the site of many wrecks.

name: Twilight Void
description: Region of the Magic Realm whose Aquam province houses the being Leviathan.

name: Vestige
description: A tether to a being in the Magic Realm that can serve as a gateway into it; Big Harcar is a level 4 vestige.

name: Second Sight
description: Supernatural ability to see through illusions and invisible spirits.

name: Awareness
description: Ability to notice things, e.g. the sculptural features of Big Harcar.

name: Leviathan
description: Vast ancient being of the Aquam province of the Twilight Void tethered to Big Harcar, which desires the destruction of certain ships; Osgood's master.

name: Clove Car
description: Low-lying hidden rock that shreds ship hulls near Big Harcar.

name: Craford's Gut
description: The only safe water between Longstone End and Little Harcar.

name: Longstone
description: Outer island with Magic aura 3 favored by magical seabirds; has a fish-shaped rock that turns jumpers into fish; best site for a covenant.

name: Fool's Light
description: Ignis fatuus, a mysterious light on the Northern Hares that causes wrecks.

name: Gruagachan
description: Hedge wizards whose tattoos resemble the carving on Longstone's fish rock.

name: Knivestone
description: Three knife-like rocks among the outer Farnes.

name: Evil Spirits
description: The lowest demonic order, to which the demons of Megstone belong.

name: Demons of Futility
description: Evil spirit demons (Infernal Might 5 Aquam) imprisoned on Megstone who drown sailors and encourage despair; appear as short black hooded creatures riding goats.

name: Decrepitude
description: Aging damage; the imprisoned Megstone demons are riddled with it.

name: Islestone Shad
description: Islet entrance (with Glororum Shad) to a regio with a Magic aura of 3 containing a half-living tree.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Mystery Initiation that might allow extending regiones.

name: Crumstone
description: Isolated islet with Magic aura 2 where Osgood lives in a hut.

name: Abjurer
description: A criminal of status forced to abjure the kingdom rather than face execution.

name: Drowned Man
description: A person who died at sea and was returned to life by a mysterious sea power, like Osgood.

name: Bréhat Archipelago
description: Island group off Brittany's north coast, an alternative location for the Farne Islands.

name: Saint Maudez
description: Sixth-century saint who cleared Maudez Island of vermin; can substitute for Saint Cuthbert.

name: Orthon
description: Breton noble version of Osgood in the Bréhat variant.

name: Brijuni Islands
description: Island group off Croatia in the northern Adriatic, an alternative Farne location.

name: Istrian Peninsula
description: Peninsula near the Brijuni Islands, home to the oppidum of Histria.

name: Bonosus
description: Repudiated fifth-century bishop of Sardica who exiled himself to Veliki Brijun and initiated the Bonosian heresy.

name: Bonosian heresy
description: Heresy teaching Mary had other children after Jesus, persisting into the eighth century.

name: Saint Jerome
description: Saint after whom Bonosus named an island (Sveti Jerolim).

name: Obrad
description: Exiled Serbian župan version of Osgood in the Brijuni variant.

name: Histria
description: Oppidum on the Istrian Peninsula in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Shrouded Bay
description: Oppidum on the island of Cres in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

name: Oppidum
description: What magi of the Transylvanian Tribunal have instead of covenants.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal whose magi dwell in oppida.

name: Loch Cuan
description: Huge sea loch in Ulster (Strangford Loch) with legendary 365 islands; an alternative Farne location.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal containing Ulster and Loch Cuan.

name: Machaoi Island
description: Island in Loch Cuan home to Saint Machaoi; its monastery was destroyed in a battle between Pralix and Diedne in 806.

name: Pralix
description: Magus who fought a magical battle with Diedne in 806 at Machaoi Island.

name: House Diedne
description: Hermetic House whose magi fought Pralix and Averna of Tytalus; destroyed in the Schism War.

name: Pontine Islands
description: Island group in the Tyrrhenian Sea in the Roman Tribunal, legendarily occupied by sirens.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Hermetic Tribunal containing the Pontine Islands and Sardinia.

name: Saracens
description: Raiders whose attacks left Ponza vacant.

name: Sirens
description: Faeries of legend occupying the Pontine Islands; treated as tritons.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural alteration from prolonged exposure to auras, e.g. warped puffins.

name: Familiar
description: Animal companion bonded to a magus; many Farne creatures would suit.

name: Fish
description: Generic template for fish of the Farnes, with variants crab, dogfish, dolphin, eel, grey mullet, mackerel, octopus, salmon, sole.

name: Remora
description: Magic Animal fish (Magic Might 20 Aquam) able to hold ships motionless with its Holdfast power.

name: Holdfast
description: Remora power duplicating any movement-inhibiting spell up to level 35.

name: Magic Animal
description: Virtue marking a creature as a magical animal.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue possessed by the remora and demons of futility.

name: Magical Seabirds
description: Magic Animal birds arriving at the Farnes from March, whose overwintering location is unknown.

name: Eider Duck of Virtue
description: Magic Animal eider ducks aligned to both Magic and Divine, whose Quell the Savage Waves power calms waves.

name: Quell the Savage Waves
description: Eider Duck power (ReAq 35) dampening waves within ten paces.

name: Lesser Benediction
description: Virtue aligning a creature to the Divine as well as another realm.

name: Homing Instinct
description: Virtue of the Eider Duck of Virtue.

name: Puffin Joker
description: Puffin warped by the magic of the Outer Farnes whose silly dance compels laughter.

name: Mentem Monstrosity
description: Warping Flaw of the Puffin Joker.

name: Storm Birds
description: Cormorants, petrels and fulmars associated with stormy weather.

name: External Vis
description: Virtue of the selkie king, whose vis is his name.

name: Master of Skills
description: Faerie role of selkie men challenging mortals in contests.

name: Faerie Spouse
aliases: Faerie Spouses Trapped by a Trinket
description: Faerie role of selkie women trapped by a trinket (their seal skin).

name: Long-Winded
description: Virtue of grey seals aiding air deprivation rolls.

name: Puissant Swim
description: Virtue boosting swimming, possessed by seals and demons of futility.

name: Vita Sancti Cuthberti
description: Hagiography of Saint Cuthbert, tractatus on Organization Lore: The Church; two versions by Bede.

name: Venerable Bede
description: Local saint who wrote two Vitae of Saint Cuthbert and the Ecclesiastical History of the English People.

name: The Ecclesiastical History of the English People
description: Encyclopedia by Bede of four tractatus of Quality 9.

name: Organization Lore
description: Knowledge of organizations, e.g. Organization Lore: The Church and Order of Hermes.

name: Theology
description: Ability covered by Bede's history (saints).

name: Divine Lore
description: Knowledge of the Divine; the Farne Meditations is a summa on it.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A mystical link to a source; washed-up vis is an Arcane Connection to its origin.

name: Genius Procellosus
description: Storm spirit of the elements (Magic Might 10 Auram) claiming a Farne rock and calling storms; appears as a seabird.

name: Storm-Calling
description: Power of the storm spirit duplicating Creo or Rego Auram effects up to level 35.

name: Penetration
description: Ability to overcome Magic Resistance with powers.

name: Magic Spirit
description: Virtue marking a creature as a magical spirit.

name: Crushing Doubt
description: Demon of Futility power preventing victims from spending Confidence.

name: Obsession
description: Demonic power imposing a Trait such as Helpless.

name: Coagulation
description: Demonic power to form a physical body.

name: Conjuring the Mystic Tower
description: Spell to create a tower; impractical on the Farnes as too obvious.

name: Poisoned Earth
description: Former Roman lead mine in the Mendip Hills with Magic aura 5, site of a Schism War duel between Averna and the Diedne.

name: Mendip Hills
description: Low limestone hills in Somerset, richest Roman lead source in Britain.

name: Averna of Tytalus
description: Corporeal necromancer who fought the Diedne at the Mendip site during the Schism War, leaving undead guardians.

name: House Tytalus
description: Hermetic House of Averna, whose magi tell horror stories of the site.

name: Schism War
description: War within the Order during which Averna dueled the Diedne.

name: March
description: Hermetic punishment (Wizard's March) Averna would have faced in peacetime.

name: Defixione
description: Lead curse-tablet necromancy practiced by descendants of Guorna the Fetid.

name: Guorna the Fetid
description: Hermetic figure whose descendants practice defixione cursing.

name: Necromancy
description: Magic of the dead practiced by Averna.

name: Somerset
description: English county ('Land of Summer') with no winter faeries; contains the Mendip Hills.

name: Bath
description: Place in Somerset described elsewhere in the book.

name: Seekers
description: Hermetic seekers who assessed the Mendip site.

name: Blue Apples of Twilight
description: Poisonous blue apples from a tree rising over a Roman slave grave 13 times a year; fermented, they yield Perdo vis.

name: Twilight
description: Wizard's Twilight; the apples may force magi into Temporary Twilight.

name: Cave of the Inscription
description: Cave under the Mendips with Magic aura 6 bearing the Inscription that binds Winter faeries; site of Averna's laboratory.

name: Summer Fae of Somerset
description: Summer faeries that the Second Working could trap.

name: Rio Tinto
description: Iberian lead source, alternative location.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Rio Tinto.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing the Harz mountains and Cologne.

name: Harz Mountains
description: Largest lead mines in Europe in 1220.

name: Cologne
description: Great lead market in the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Argentiera
description: Sardinian lead mine in the Roman Tribunal.

name: Silver Lady
description: Faerie (Faerie Might 35 Corpus) Queen of the Lifeless Hills guarding the poisoned land, riding a lead hog and killing miners.

name: The Inscription
description: Ancient story on a cave wall binding Winter from Somerset; Averna believed it a Titan weapon.

name: Second Working
description: Unread working that, if inscribed, would trap the Summer Fae of Somerset.

name: Watching Ward
description: Averna's single-use ward (PeCo 40) that turns victims to maggots.

name: Titans
description: Ancients whose war between Faerie and Magic left the Inscription.

name: King Bladud
description: Chthonic wizard-king who rediscovered the Inscription.

name: Apollo
description: God whom Bladud sought to woo.

name: Wookey Hole
description: Caverns in the Mendip Hills where a witch faerie is imprisoned as a stalagmite.

name: Witch of Wookey Hole
description: Blear-eyed hag faerie turned into a stalagmite by a Glastonbury monk; source of Perdo vis.

name: Glastonbury
description: Abbey whose abbot sent a monk against the Witch.

name: Spirit Anchor
description: An object anchoring a faerie; the stalagmite ball of the Witch.

name: Somerset Levels
description: Marshy Somerset coast where magical teasels grow.

name: Magical Teasel
description: Pixie-grown teasel giving +2 to thread-crafting and containing Herbam vis.

name: Pixies
description: Minor faeries of Somerset, jovial and rarely malicious; called pisgies in Cornwall and Devon.

name: Joan the Wad
description: Will-o-the-wisp Queen of the Pisgies in Devon and Cornwall.

name: Cornwall
description: Region neighboring Somerset where pisgies are vicious.

name: Devon
description: Region neighboring Somerset.

name: Arsenical Pseudoelemental
description: Earth spirit (Magic Might 20 Terram) made cruel by arsenic salts.

name: Way of the Poisoned Land
description: Virtue granting bonuses in poisoned places.

name: Crush
description: Pseudoelemental power.

name: Slake Elemental Thirst
description: Pseudoelemental power (PeAq 15) draining fluid.

name: Arsenical Skeletons
description: Undead animated by Averna's Ritual, poisonous.

name: Distorted Ghosts
description: Ghosts of miners bound and warped by Averna (Magic Might 6 Mentem).

name: Donning the Corporeal Veil
description: Lesser Power letting ghosts take material form.

name: House Criamon
description: Claims its Founder made Roman ghosts black.

name: Alchemical Sublimation
description: Silver Lady power melting base metals.

name: Allure
description: Silver Lady power granting +3 to impress.

name: Breath of the Poisoned Land
description: Silver Lady power releasing arsenic breeze.

name: Cause Poisoning
description: Silver Lady power coating objects in lead or arsenic.

name: Lead Mania
description: Silver Lady power similar to Blessing of Childlike Bliss.

name: Spirit Away
description: Faerie power to whisk humans into Faerie lands.

name: Stench of Twenty Corpses
description: ArM5 spell basis for Breath of the Poisoned Land.

name: Blessing of Childlike Bliss
description: ArM5 spell basis for Lead Mania.

name: Silver Lady's Mount
description: Lead-armored hog that is an extension of the Silver Lady's body.

name: Averna's Hogs
description: Small savage humanoid hog faeries with lead in their flesh.

name: Supernatural Agility
description: Averna's hogs' power for tricks.

name: Pandius
description: Vessel of Iniquity demon who teaches secret poisoning; appears as a scorpion-man.

name: Maggots
description: Tiny flying demons causing madness, serving Pandius.

name: Vessels of Iniquity
description: Demonic order of Pandius.

name: Envisioning
description: Demonic power to twist dreams.

name: Contagious Obsession
description: Pandius's contagious obsession power.

name: Possession
description: Demonic power to control a host.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Protection that demonic powers must penetrate.

name: Ritual
description: Ritual spells, e.g. animating skeletons.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art named in effect or vis descriptions.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art named in effect or vis descriptions.

description: Hermetic Art named in effect or vis descriptions.

description: Hermetic Art named in effect or vis descriptions.
